relation.note: Heard part of Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī from al-Ḥajjār (#TMP-P-000275). Bibl reference corrected from #TMP-T-00035 to wd:Q1023470 (Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī), per the B14 consolidation of TMP-T-00035 into wd:Q1023470.

Subject was a mawlā (freedman/client) of Ibn al-Qawwās (placeholder #TMP-P-000641). Scrutiny (B15): "Ibn al-Qawwās" in the corpus splits into (a) the frequently-cited Damascene ḥadīth musnid Ibrāhīm b. (Muḥammad b.) Yūnus b. al-Qawwās — no headword (pre-9th-c., below the dictionary's scope), and (b) the sole headword candidate ʿUmar b. Ibrāhīm b. al-Qawwās al-Dimashqī al-Sukkarī (#AIND-D05783, d. 801 H). Timeframe (master d. 801, freedman d. 815, both Damascene) fits D05783; kept as leading candidate (cert low) pending repo/printed-edition confirmation. Replaces the contamination number #TMP-P-000066 (= al-Sharaf b. al-Kuwayk / #AIND-D08850).

Strong duplicate candidate: Ṭaybughā al-Turkī, fatā of Ibn al-Qawwās (#AIND-D03453), also d. 815 H — matching on nisbah (al-Turkī), master (Ibn al-Qawwās), and death year; the name difference Ṭanbughā/Ṭaybughā is a routine ن/ي ductus confusion. Note (B15 scrutiny): al-Sakhāwī's own "yuḥarrar maʿa alladhī qablahu" in D03453 points to the PRECEDING entry #AIND-D03452 (Ṭaybughā al-Sharīfī, a calligrapher and freedman of a DIFFERENT master, al-Sharīf Shihāb al-Dīn naqīb al-ashrāf of Aleppo) — that cross-reference is a mis-link; the true near-duplicate is the present entry (D02057). Kept unmerged as bidirectional possible_identity per §4-15; final merge/keep decision and reciprocal on D03453 → Waka.

event.desc: Did not become prominent until shortly before his death.
It is not known that he transmitted (ḥadīth), but some of al-Sakhāwī's companions received an ijāza from him; he was the last of the men to hear from al-Ḥajjār.

event.note: Reported by our shaykh Ibn Ḥajar in his Inbāʾ al-Ghumr (Pattern A mention).

person.note: タンブガー・アッ＝トゥルキー・アッ＝ディマシュキー、イブン・アル＝カッワースのマウラー。ハッジャールから『ブハーリー』の一部を聴聞したが、彼が世に現れたのは死の直前になってからで、彼がハディースを伝えたとは聞いていない。しかし、我らの仲間の何人かが彼からイジャーザを受けており、彼はハッジャールから聴聞した最後の男性であると、我らがシャイフ（イブン・ハジャル）がその著『インバーウ（＝インバーウ・アル＝グムル）』で述べた。815年に亡くなった。

Ṭanbughā al-Turkī al-Dimashqī, mawlā of Ibn al-Qawwās. He heard part of al-Bukhārī from al-Ḥajjār. He did not become prominent until shortly before his death, and we do not know that he transmitted (ḥadīth). However, some of our companions received an ijāza from him, as our shaykh (Ibn Ḥajar) stated in his 『Inbāʾ al-Ghumr』; he said that he was the last of the men to hear from al-Ḥajjār. He died in the year 815.
